ledger: Station wagon | parked on the right shoulder of a desert road facing foreground-left, with solid hood and wood-paneled front-left fender in foreground and windshield/cabin behind | close-up of hood and windshield area | camera dollies in and arcs slightly left from 00:00 to 00:09

Woman | leaning with crossed arms on the surface of the car hood in front of the driver-side windshield and A-pillar | remains in the same position embedded in the hood in front of the windshield | turns head slightly as hair blows in the wind

Desert road and background mountains | highway stretching into the distance on the left with desert scrub and mountains behind | background shifts smoothly with camera parallax | maintains consistent spatial layout throughout the shot

findings.description: The woman is spatially positioned in front of the windshield, wipers, and driver-side A-pillar, with her crossed arms resting on the hood and her lower torso disappearing directly into the solid metal of the hood and front-left fender rather than emerging from a window or cabin opening.
